Resolves #21274

🌿 The Table Filtering cover can be captured again: its check looks for the field where a table cell keeps it, in its id.

The `table-filtering` recipe's second `after` check asked for `.neo-table-cell[data-field='customer']`. Only grid cells render `data-field` (`src/grid/Row.mjs:30`). A table cell carries its field in its id (`src/table/Body.mjs` `getCellId`). The check now matches `.neo-table-cell[id$='__customer']`.

Evidence: L3 (the producer's capture at this head) → L3 required (AC-1).

On `dev` `a2d97b19b8` the same run fails: `element(s) not found` after 15 s. |

- The capture shows the example's title and intro in the browser's default serif font. That comes from the example (bare `h1`/`p`), not from this recipe, and is reported separately.
